question.scope_of_answer: economics of THIS assay only (see claim ceiling): a serving-volume break-even statement about frozen worlds, the frozen registered learner, and the frozen dev-learned gate; nothing else

design.worlds: byte-identical frozen M1/M1B worlds: M1_PARTITIONS_V1.json sha256 a5b0cbc1814042a7b4ddcfbc8658e63c4b352fade22cfdcd91c1968bea13921e, protected set 62f199960eecfb0822bc724be9877cef9aa0fa87695917ead50ab4b1d98b236a; verified at every phase entry by the unmodified m1b_runner.verify_frozen_worlds (mismatch aborts before anything runs)
design.learner: src/ocm/learning/methods.py bound AS-IS, imported and driven; never edited (registered M.solve, registered timing, registered cost; no admission loosening, no tau or threshold tuning anywhere in this lane)
design.dev_phase: executed identically ONCE per run: the M1B phase_dev on the frozen worlds at the frozen dev budget 200000 slots, gated on BOTH frozen identities -- mined-fragment fingerprint 70d8cad4ce2189eebf878eeaa1dc597cb20dbf68d157712b6983505543ed72bc AND candidate_enumerations_dev == 14,427,131 (the sealed M1B dev cost); any mismatch = RECEIPT_BINDING_DEFECT (worlds or learner drifted) and the run halts. RE-EXECUTION is the registered path; REPLAY of the sealed M1B dev state (scored_v1/run/dev_state.json) is allowed ONLY if the replayed state is byte-identical to a fresh re-execution (fingerprint AND dev cost AND fragment library AND trace count) AND the recorded cost 14,427,131 is STILL charged in full to every arm that uses dev history -- this freeze registers re-execution and permits replay only under that byte-identity + full-charge condition
design.dev_charge_ledger_entry: the dev cost is ONE fixed ledger entry of the run, the identical number 14,427,131 in every arm that uses dev history: never re-executed per arm, never amortised differently per arm, never scaled by T. RESET runs no dev phase and carries no dev charge (its lane cost is serving burden only); the gate lane pays the fixed entry once. The vs-RESET NET therefore subtracts the entry exactly once, identically at every T
design.serving_unit: one serve = one acquisition of one target-list entry at the single registered serving budget 200,000 slots (the M1B top rung: the only rung where RESET and STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT both verify 8/8 targets in the M1B receipts, i.e. a completed serve; lower rungs leave RESET censored at budget, which is not a completed acquisition)
design.target_list: the frozen protected stream (144 rows) in frozen stream order, cyclically repeated to the rung length; T-rungs are PREFIXES of this one list (a serve at rung T is the first T entries). Identical re-serves are the registered amortisation reality (a deployed gate serves the same ecology repeatedly) and are exact: the search is deterministic, so every re-serve of the same target costs the same slots. The protected stream is the only non-history stream (train/validation/test are history for the leakage gate), so cyclic reuse of protected rows is the only frozen-worlds-compliant way to exceed 144 serves

ladder.justification_from_m1b_receipts: break-even estimates from the sealed M1B run: pooled-budget checker N* = 330.7 (STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT), 316.5 (APPL_ORACLE), 447.7 (INTG_ORACLE); recomputed at the registered 200k serving budget from the same receipts, per-serve mean B: RESET 56,601, STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT 3,810, KS 37,316, giving per-serve slack (R-A-0.2*(R-K)) = 48,934 slots -> margin-bar N* = 14,427,131/48,934 = 294.8 serves and plain-net N* = 14,427,131/52,791 = 273.3 serves. The ladder {8, 32, 128, 512} straddles every estimate: 128 < 273 <= N* <= 448 < 512, with 8 = the M1B target count (run-to-run continuity) and 4x spacing
ladder.redraw_forbidden: the rungs are fixed by this freeze before any serve is run; no redraw after seeing results

design.obligations: the frozen M1B obligation shape is preserved at the T=8 rung only (protected rows 8..39 served once per arm at 200k, reported, never part of the T-ladder); at rungs >= 32 the target stream subsumes the protected set and no separate obligation set is defined

arms.resolution_note: the coordinator's minimal list names 'dev-learned gate arm, RESET, STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT'; the dev-learned applicability gate IS the M1B STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT decision-list machinery (there is exactly one dev-learned gate in the frozen estate; building another would be a new mechanism, forbidden). STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT therefore carries BOTH roles in ONE arm: the dev-learned gate under test AND the strongest parent riding the whole ladder. APPL_ORACLE and KNOWN_STRUCTURE_ORACLE are calibration riders (denominator / perfect-gate bound), never headline comparators
arms.RESET: no learned history; registered primitive search; the anchor
arms.STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT: the M1B arm byte-identically: decision-list applicability fit on DEV data only, frozen normal-form partition features, own persistence outside OCM bookkeeping, serving the SAME mined fragments through the REGISTERED M.solve (timing and cost untouched); its store bytes are honestly charged in the HDI-14 ledger (storage family, never converted to slots)

arms.KNOWN_STRUCTURE_ORACLE: calibration rider only; the recovery_i denominator (M1B role unchanged)
arms.no_new_mechanisms: every arm is M1B machinery reused byte-identically; no new arm, gate, learner, or serving path may be added at any stage

primary.name: crossing of the dev-learned gate into net-positive vs RESET
primary.curve: net(T) = sum_{i<=T} (B_RESET,i - B_GATE,i) - 14,427,131, computed on the serve prefix at every T from 1 to 512; reported as the crossing curve with bootstrap CI at each rung (percentile bootstrap over the 144 distinct protected targets resampled with replacement at equal n, deterministic re-serve costs, frozen seed)
primary.statistic: PRIMARY = the first T (continuous, then located between rungs if interior) where net(T) > 0, claimed only if the rung family is Holm-rejected: at each rung T_r in {8,32,128,512} the per-serve net contribution d_i = (B_RESET,i - B_GATE,i) - dev/T_r is tested against 0 by the frozen sign-flip permutation null (equal-n, paired), Holm-adjusted across the 4 rungs at alpha = 0.05; the crossing claim requires Holm rejection at every rung >= the crossing rung (monotone net growth makes this the natural family reading) with the rung bootstrap CI of net(T_r) excluding 0
primary.crossing_readout_terms: T*_continuous (first serve index with net > 0), T*_rung (first rung with net > 0 and Holm rejection), bootstrap CI of T*_continuous (target-resample), and the crossing curve table net(T_r) with CI at each rung

secondary.name: the same crossing curve under the DEV-CAL-4 frozen corrected acquisition-charging semantics
secondary.semantics: MARGINAL_COST_ONLY_AT_FROZEN_N with N_FROZEN = 30, EXACTLY as frozen in research/hsg-semantic-execution-v1/exact/DEV_CAL_4_ACQUISITION_CHARGING_FREEZE_V1.json (PR #355, merge 26736643): the acquisition (dev-enumeration) charge amortises across the asset's first N_FROZEN uses at raw/30 per use and retires (charges zero) after use 30; no other charge component changes; work readouts never touched. Applied here as: serve i of the gate asset charges 14,427,131/30 slots for i in 1..30 and 0 after, so net_devcal4(T) = sum_{i<=T}(B_RESET,i - B_GATE,i) - min(T,30) * 14,427,131/30; cited, never re-derived or altered
secondary.pre_registered_expectation: the two accountings converge at T >= 30 (both charge the dev cost exactly once in full); they differ only in the early-T region, which the secondary reports; the crossing statistic is therefore expected to agree with the primary and any disagreement is REPORTED, not resolved by choice
secondary.label: SECONDARY -- clearly labelled everywhere it appears; never merged into the primary claim

readouts.tertiary_work_readouts: recovery_i (work, uncharged) = (B_RESET - B_arm)/(B_RESET - B_KNOWN_STRUCTURE_ORACLE) at matched keys per rung (the M1B statistic, m1b_stats.recovery_share semantics, MARGIN 0.20); per-rung verified_external counts per arm (checker-C verified); per-rung mean B per arm; STRONG_ADAPTIVE_PARENT decision-rule distribution over serves (which rule fired); all reported per rung, none of them the primary

null_discipline.shuffle_equal_n: at EVERY rung: (1) the paired sign-flip permutation null on the per-serve net contributions d_i (frozen seed 20260910, PERM_N as registered in m1b_stats); (2) an equal-n label-shuffle null: the two arms' per-target serve burdens are pooled per distinct target and arm labels shuffled at equal n, giving the null distribution of the mean per-serve difference; the observed effect must beat both nulls where claimed, and a null that fails to reject where the effect is claimed voids the claim at that rung
null_discipline.no_alarm_controls: each null checker must PASS a no-alarm control on planted in-distribution data (selftest stage) before the run; an alarm on control data is an assay defect
